data: Amazon reported diluted earnings per share of $5.53 in fiscal 2024, up from $2.90 in fiscal 2023, an increase of about 90.7%. Net income for fiscal 2024 was $59.2 billion, compared with $30.4 billion in fiscal 2023, which is roughly a 95% rise. The figures come from Amazon's annual reports as I recall them, and I did not pull the filings in this session, so confirm them against the 10-K if precision matters.
